source_description: User-supplied Pixel Watch 2 dtbo.img binary; raw firmware not included in repository
accompanying_boot_fingerprint: CP1A.260305.014.W2 (found in separately supplied boot.img; precise DTBO OTA provenance unverified)
scope: Six fixed reg properties in /fragment@reserved-memory/__overlay__ across every DTBO entry; these are overlays, NOT the complete effective bootloader memory map.
parsing_note: Use reg cells, not node suffixes. Three IPA/GPU nodes contain stale @547xxxxx suffixes, while reg is 0x549xxxxx.
